vocabulary.done: the source obligation in the item's exit criteria is implemented and pinned by a host test, simulator row or CI job
vocabulary.partial: part of the exit criteria is implemented and the remainder is named
vocabulary.none: no source work has been done

note: hardware_verified stays false until a run logs the evidence. Nothing in this tree has ever executed on a GPU.

items.note: Runtime selector over the live inventory (GuTargets plus console choice); ordered coordinator unchanged.

Runtime ESP identification plus the BootOrder cross-check: the selected volume must be named by a Boot#### that BootOrder lists, a readable order naming none refuses, and an unreadable order is logged as unchecked instead of counting as a pass.
Build-time multi-target coupling removed; admission stays fail-closed without the waiver. Needs two physical cards.
An image refuses a card whose captured stock value it was not built for; choosing the entry-latched policy at runtime has no cold-state evidence.
Uncaptured Ada SKUs are refused and Turing is refused at build time; the per-SKU tables and the Turing payload are data, not code.
A GU_ASSET_INSTALL_ONLY build stages and re-verifies the bundle on the ESP; the launch rule, signature acceptance and the 84 MB decision are open.
The INTENT/OUTCOME record exists and is inert; whether re-application is safe is unproven, so the contract is still open.
Recovery matrix pinned to log lines and the boot record, plus an opt-in bounded timer. Nothing is verified on hardware.
An AMD display function must own the console (msi_release.c:695).
Headless needs a surviving non-target GOP; non-headless needs exactly one target GOP.
MSI/MSI-X must be enabled-off and the function in D0 at admission; PMC version and PMCSR state are both checked (§11.20).
Any PCI capability id outside PM/MSI/MSI-X/PCIe/vendor is refused, as is a vendor capability shorter than its header (§11.20).
PCIe endpoint v1/v2 only (device type <= 1), FLR capability advertised, and no already-initiated FLR in Device Control (§11.20).
The firmware BAR descriptor is authoritative: any power-of-two window of at least 16 MiB, config mismatch refused.
AllocateMaxAddress asks for a sub-4 GiB buffer up front; the mapped-ceiling check stays as the last defence.
Bus Master off at admission; the one exception is the single-target read-only inspection, which cannot survive into the transaction (§11.20).
A resident build may start from the Windows ESP behind five gates and a provable writable log; the default build still names its refusal. Never booted.
Per-call DMA, 1 MiB ROM buffer and the radix table multiply with card count and are untested.
A pre-Stop capture and a ten-requirement contract exist and are pinned by host tests; the bound, the signed-Booter comparison and the recovery evidence are still absent.

DMA quiescence after Stop now polls the PCIe Transaction Pending bit five times and refuses a card that never drains, retaining its buffers; there is still no IOMMU, queue readback or bus trace, and the poll bound is a count, not a measured budget.
Firmware acceptance is a structural parse and a digest log; SIGNATURE_AUTHENTICATED=0.
A per-card ROM allowlist exists but carries no references, and it is a digest, not a signature.
Post-state verification proves the registers written, not the unlock.
A bound can be armed per build; no worst-case duration has been measured, so the default arms nothing.
Post-FLR expectations are board-observed values assumed for every board.

The PCIe link is read at admission: sticky errors, an ASPM request this image does not manage, an untrained or down link, and an unusable width/speed refuse the active path. AER lives in extended config space and is logged as unobserved; hot-plug events, training recovery and tunneled links are still unhandled.
A two-card host model now executes selection and per-target admission from real code (§11.22); nothing has run with two physical cards, and the per-card memory footprint (B10) is still unmeasured.
S3/resume behaviour is written but never verified.
Every variant is signed inside WSL with a personal certificate, and signing refuses unless that certificate is already in the BIOS db. One machine's trust, no CA, no timestamp, no release key.
The Windows job compiles the admitted image and the host job diffs it; nothing is published.
The 84 MB payloads have no provenance beyond local hashes.
MSVC-only toolchain and a disabled installer.
No hardware-in-the-loop: CI proves compilation and host logic. The session now has a machine go/no-go gate (§11.21), but no stage runs or is scored automatically.
Stock Windows 617.42 must accept a modified card.
Tensor Core numerical correctness after modification.
Tensor Core throughput and the rate-limiter effect.
The recovery matrix executed, including a mid-transaction power loss.
Multi-GPU end to end on real hardware.
BDF stability across firmware updates and slot changes.
Coupling to the 610.43.03 asset lineage across driver updates.
AD104/AD106/AD107 and the GA102 variants that are not 0x2684/0x220a.
Thermal, power and long-run stability.
Interaction with Secure Boot, BitLocker and anti-cheat.
